Title: Azure Cognitive Services Translator - Inuktitut language text translation now available

Body.Content:
You can now add Inuktitut text translation, the language of the Inuit of northern Canada, into your apps, products, and workflows with Translator. Translate to or from Inuktitut into any of the more than 70 languages available in Translator. Learn more about this language release in the Translator blog.

See more information on other languages that Translator supports.
